extraction_scope: worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF text and figure captions; packet worker-5 scaffold was treated as prior evidence only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Px-Mor treatment of A. pullulans at 30 μM for 3 h is reported to cause morphological alteration, membrane disruption, and unclear cytoplasmic contents in SEM/TEM observations.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Effect of Px-Mor on A. pullulans Morphology; xml:fig=6; xml:fig=7

mechanism_claims.limitations: Microscopy supports membrane/cell-structure disruption for A. pullulans morphology; it is not a quantitative killing mechanism assay for every Table 1 target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Px-Mor is interpreted as a moricin/cecropin-type alpha-helical antimicrobial peptide; the paper discusses N-terminal amphipathic and C-terminal hydrophobic regions by homology to moricins.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Sequence Characteristics of Full-Length Px-Mor; xml:fig=1; supp:Supplementary Figure S1

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is structural/contextual evidence and is not promoted to direct mechanism for all organisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Px-Mor expression is reported across P. xylostella life stages and immune tissues and is induced after microbial challenge, supporting an immune-response role.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Px-Mor gene expression in Plutella xylostella

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Px-Mor Expression Patterns in P. xylostella; xml:sec=The Relative Expression of Px-Mor Upon Infection With Different Microorganisms; xml:fig=3; xml:fig=4

mechanism_claims.limitations: Expression induction is not direct antimicrobial activity and is kept separate from Table 1 MIC rows.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Final mechanism claims do not overextend SEM/TEM A. pullulans findings to every bacterial/fungal Table 1 target.
